title: API tokens
intro: API tokens let scripts and CI jobs use this tenant without a personal login. A token can only manage monitors, notification channels and maintenance windows. Reading the audit log needs the role tenant-admin. Tokens cannot manage tokens or users. The secret is shown only once, when the token is created.
revokeText: Every script or job that uses this token loses access immediately. This cannot be undone.

dialog.title: New API token
dialog.intro: Choose a name, a role and a lifetime. The token acts for this tenant only.
dialog.onceOnly: This token is shown only now. Copy it and store it safely.
dialog.howTo: Send it as a bearer token in the Authorization header:
